summary: Frontend-only verification of BoxBuilder /menu redesign: top-sheet auto-open, category 'Full Menu' first, collection banners, per-1lb pricing, box-size styling, inline ProductDetailModal, inline FeedingCalculator overlay with Save/multi-pet, and discount badge color. 15/16 assertions PASS; 1 partial.

integration_issues.issue: Code path works when click event is dispatched directly to the box-size button (handleBoxSizeChange closes the sheet and sets sessionStorage flag). However during a real mouse click while the top-sheet is open, the .menu-topsheet-backdrop element (z-index above menu, pointer-events:auto, onClick=onClose) intercepts the click at those coordinates — so the box-size button is not reachable via genuine pointer interaction until the sheet is closed. This makes the 'select box size auto-closes top-sheet' requirement effectively a dead code path under normal UX. Suggest either removing the backdrop onClick capture or removing the auto-close branch in handleBoxSizeChange.

verified_features.topsheet_subline_text: Free delivery on orders over $100 in the GTA (up to 30km)
verified_features.collection_banner_class_present: .menu-collection-banner (2 banners on Full Menu view: Comfort Dinner + Primal Feast)

action_items: (Optional / Minor) Revisit auto-close-top-sheet-on-box-size: backdrop intercepts the click so the spec's 'selecting any box size while top-sheet is open auto-closes it' is unreachable via real pointer events. Either drop backdrop click-through or simply rely on the existing close X (which already works). No functional regression — selection still works as soon as user dismisses the sheet.
critical_code_review_comments: BoxBuilder.js is 890 lines — consider splitting MenuTopSheet, ProductCard, and overlay logic into their own files for maintainability (>700 line threshold).

useEffect with empty dependency arrays at L96 and L105 have known eslint react-hooks/exhaustive-deps warnings flagged by E1; they are acceptable since they're one-shot mount effects but could be silenced with eslint-disable-next-line comments for cleanliness.
MenuTopSheet backdrop captures clicks site-wide; consider lowering its z-index after open transition or using pointer-events:none + a transparent click-trap only on the panel.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded products (cd-chicken etc.). All test artifacts written only to sessionStorage and cleared between runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Top-sheet auto-open is gated by sessionStorage key 'foeguard_menu_topsheet_seen'. Always clear sessionStorage before re-testing. Product cards open inline modal — page never navigates to /product/:id. Calculator opens inline via [data-testid='top-nav-calculator'] or [data-testid='topsheet-calculator-link'] — both verified. Save button uses [data-testid='calc-save-btn'] and persists to sessionStorage key 'foeguard_saved_pets' for logged-out users (array of pet objects). Multi-pet titles flip from 'Pet' to 'Pet 1'/'Pet 2' upon clicking calc-add-pet.
rca of the issue: The 'box-size click auto-closes top-sheet' requirement: the MenuTopSheet renders a sibling .menu-topsheet-backdrop with onClick=onClose layered above the box-builder content. When the user attempts to click box-size-18lb under the open sheet, the click event lands on the backdrop first (which closes the sheet) rather than the box-size button. The handleBoxSizeChange auto-close branch is therefore unreachable through a real click. Verified by dispatching a synthetic 'click' event directly on the box-size button — the sheet did close and the session flag was set. Mitigation: either (a) accept the backdrop-closes-sheet behaviour and remove the now-dead branch in handleBoxSizeChange, or (b) set backdrop pointer-events:none so user clicks pass through to box-size and the handler takes over.
